title: Care Home Portfolio Development
sum: A development facility supporting the delivery of a portfolio of care homes across the UK.
ps: A development facility was arranged to support the delivery of at least twelve purpose-built care homes over the next two years for one of the UK's leading care home developers and operators.

This represents the second portfolio facility completed between Beaufort Capital and the sponsor in the past two years, further strengthening a long-term funding partnership. Once complete, the schemes will deliver high-quality residential and dementia care accommodation, helping to address the growing demand for modern, purpose-built care facilities across the UK.

ESG: The portfolio incorporates strong ESG principles, including low-carbon technologies, biodiversity enhancements and sustainable design, creating energy-efficient care homes that promote resident wellbeing, support local employment and deliver long-term social value.

title: Industrial Land Bridge
sum: A bridging facility unlocking the next phase of an industrial development.
ps: A bridge facility was secured against a consented industrial site in Leicestershire, enabling the sponsor to progress the next phase of the development and optimise its capital structure.

The funding supports the ongoing reserved matters application, associated professional costs and the return of capital to project investors. Once developed, the scheme will deliver a range of high-quality industrial units in an established employment location, where strong occupier demand continues to outpace available supply.

ESG: The development will generate employment during both the construction and operational phases, while incorporating site improvements and environmental enhancements that contribute to the long-term sustainability of the asset.

title: Care Home Development
sum: A financing package supporting both development and platform growth.
ps: A financing package was structured to fund the development of a new 80-bed purpose-built care home in East Anglia, while also providing additional capital secured against a portfolio of operational assets to support the sponsor's continued growth.

Combining senior development finance with mezzanine funding, the transaction demonstrates Beaufort's ability to deliver flexible, multi-layered capital solutions for experienced operators. Once complete, the scheme will provide high-quality elderly residential and dementia care accommodation in a region where demand for modern care facilities continues to grow.

ESG: The development has been designed to deliver modern, energy-efficient accommodation that enhances resident wellbeing while supporting the delivery of sustainable, high-quality care infrastructure for the long term.

title: Retirement Living Development
sum: A senior debt facility supporting a flagship retirement living scheme in West London.
ps: Senior debt was provided to support the development of a new purpose-built retirement living scheme in Chiswick, one of West London's most desirable and supply-constrained residential locations.

The development will deliver 50 high-quality later living apartments, together with a range of premium resident amenities and support services designed to promote independent living and wellbeing. The transaction further strengthens Beaufort's long-standing funding relationship with the sponsor and reflects our continued commitment to the growing later living sector.
ESG: The scheme has been designed with sustainability at its core, incorporating energy-efficient design and sourcing electricity exclusively from 100% renewable energy providers.

title: Industrial Development
sum: Senior debt and equity supporting the acquisition and repositioning of a multi-let industrial asset.
ps: Senior debt and equity were provided to support the acquisition and refurbishment of an 8-acre industrial and warehouse site in Wellingborough, comprising more than 100,000 sq ft of light industrial accommodation.

The acquisition represents the third investment completed with Beaufort's joint venture partner, a platform focused on acquiring, repositioning and actively managing multi-let industrial assets with strong value-add potential across the UK.

ESG: The refurbishment will deliver modern, energy-efficient industrial accommodation, incorporating improvements to the building envelope, photovoltaic (PV) panels, enhanced landscaping and upgraded yard space to create high-quality, sustainable premises for local businesses.

title: PBSA Development
sum: A development facility funding a landmark PBSA scheme in Central London.
ps: A development facility was provided to support the delivery of a 244-bed purpose-built student accommodation scheme in Elephant & Castle, one of Central London's most well-connected student locations.

The funding supports an experienced private equity real estate investment manager with a strong track record across the living and mixed-use sectors. Arranged over 24 storeys, the development will deliver premium student accommodation together with extensive resident amenities, reflecting continued demand for high-quality PBSA in London's world-leading higher education market.

ESG: The scheme targets BREEAM Excellent certification and an EPC A rating, incorporating sustainable design, energy-efficient construction and professionally managed accommodation that promotes resident wellbeing and long-term environmental performance.

title: Retirement Living Development
sum: Development finance for a premium retirement living scheme in Surrey.
ps: Development finance was provided to support the delivery of a 54-unit retirement living scheme in Surrey for one of the UK's leading retirement living developers.

The transaction represents Beaufort's fifth development facility with the sponsor, reflecting a strong, long-term funding relationship. The scheme will deliver high-quality later living accommodation together with a range of premium resident amenities, including a one-acre orchard and landscaped communal gardens, promoting independent living and community.

ESG: Sustainability is embedded throughout the development, with air source heat pumps, solar thermal panels and electricity sourced entirely from 100% renewable energy providers, helping to reduce operational carbon emissions and enhance long-term building performance.

title: Care Home Development
sum: Development finance supporting the delivery of a new purpose-built care home.
ps: Development finance was provided to support the construction of a 66-bed purpose-built care home in Gloucester for one of the UK's leading care home developers.

The transaction represents the third development financed under Beaufort's umbrella facility with the sponsor, further strengthening a long-standing funding partnership. Once complete, the scheme will provide high-quality residential care accommodation, helping to meet the growing demand for modern care facilities.

ESG: The development incorporates a range of low-carbon technologies, including ground-source heat pumps, photovoltaic (PV) panels, integrated battery storage and underfloor heating, supporting energy efficiency and long-term operational sustainability.

title: Residential Development
sum: Development finance for a high-quality residential scheme in Surrey.
ps: Development finance was provided to support the delivery of 28 new homes in Virginia Water, one of Surrey's most sought-after residential locations.

The transaction represents the fourth development financed for the sponsor, an experienced residential developer with a strong track record across the Home Counties, further demonstrating Beaufort's commitment to building long-term funding partnerships with repeat borrowers.

ESG: The development has been designed with sustainability in mind, incorporating EV charging infrastructure, biodiversity enhancements and homes targeting an EPC A rating to deliver energy-efficient, future-proofed accommodation.

title: Residential Development
sum: A facility to fund the development of 125 homes in Nottinghamshire
ps: This facility will be used to fund the construction of 125 new homes in Nottinghamshire for an experienced regional housebuilder, with a forecast GDV of over £40m.

This is the second peak-debt facility for the developer, under a £50m overall facility. It is anticipated that the overall facility will be used to fund seven development projects across Yorkshire, Derbyshire and Nottinghamshire.
ESG: The homes will boast strong ESG credentials, such as EV charging points, PV panels, low energy lighting and energy-efficient mechanical ventilation.

title: Light Industrial Development
sum: A facility to fund the acquisition and refurbishment of 140,000sqft of light industrial space in Cambridgeshire
ps: Beaufort and Marchdown Holdings have completed the purchase of an 8-acre, 140,000 sqft industrial and warehouse complex in Peterborough.

This is the second acquisition for the Beaufort-Marchdown JV, where Beaufort is providing both debt and equity, set up specifically to acquire multi-let industrial estates requiring active management, repositioning and refurbishment.

ESG: The refurbishment works undertaken by Marchdown will provide a more modern and thoughtful working environment, providing high quality industrial units and extensive secure yard space, alongside a number of sustainability initiatives including an improved building envelope, PV Panels, and enhanced landscaping.

title: Residential Developments
sum: A facility to fund the development of multiple residential projects across Yorkshire and the East Midlands
ps: This revolving facility will be utilised to fund multiple new-build residential housing developments across Yorkshire, Nottinghamshire and Derbyshire.
The facility will initially fund the construction of 128 homes for private sale near Doncaster, Yorkshire.
Further residential projects across the region will be added to the facility during 2025.
ESG: All homes will feature EV charging points, PV panels and will be built to high energy-efficiency standards.

title: Care Home Developments
sum: A facility to fund the development of multiple care homes across the UK
ps: This revolving facility will be utilised to fund multiple new-build care homes with this highly-regarded and experienced care home developer; the largest and best-known developer of care homes in the UK.
It is envisaged that the facility will support between four and five care home developments at any one time.
ESG: All new homes achieve EPC 'A' rating

title: Planning Transaction
sum: A facility to fund the refinance and planning of a residential site in St. Albans
ps: The facility will be used to refinance an existing facility on the site, and provide sufficient time for the borrower to sign the Section 106 Agreement, having already received a resolution to grant at planning committee.
The site has a resolution to grant planning consent for 190 homes, with a forecast GDV of c. £140m.

ESG: The development will boast strong ESG credentials, including new bicycle, pedestrian, and horse crossings, a net biodiversity gain of over 100%, and extensive landscaping and green space throughout the site. 67 affordable homes are also planned to be delivered as part of the development.

title: Residential Development
sum: A facility to fund the development of new family homes in Central London
ps: This project will involve the demolition of a vacant educational facility, and the construction of new family homes in the heart of Kensington.
The homes will feature thoughtfully-designed layouts that incorporate interior and exterior spaces and luxury finishes, while being positioned in a highly desirable London neighbourhood.
The borrower group is a highly-regarded developer of residential accommodation in Prince Central London, with an enviable track record of development in some of London’s most sought-after addresses.
ESG: The development will be 100% car-free, and will include air-source heat pumps, PV panels, and dedicated cycle parking for each unit

title: Care Home Development
sum: A facility to fund the development of an 82-bed care home in SW London
ps: The facility will support the refinancing and development of the site, which will specialise in the provision of elderly and dementia care.
The new facility will feature state-of-the-art amenities, positioning it as a premier choice in the local area. Once developed, is projected to have a stabilised GDV in excess of £50 million.

The borrower is a major UK provider of long-term care and consistently ranked as a Top 20 recommended UK care home group. The new care home will feature state-of-the-art amenities, positioning it as a premier choice in the region.

ESG: The Project is targeting BREEAM Excellent and delivering a number of wellness-focused elements including CHP energy systems, green living walls, central courtyard with a focus on natural light, and LED lighting throughout.

title: PBSA Development
sum: A facility to fund the development of 321 PBSA studios in Glasgow
ps: This project will involve the demolition of a former city centre office building, and the delivery of a modern PBSA project, which will appeal to a wide range of students in the city.

This design-led scheme will also boast a café and co-working space on the ground floor, with bookable meeting / event spaces, student lounge, study room, gym and 685sqm (7,375sqft) of outside terrace space split across five floors. In total, there will be an impressive 5sqm of amenity space per bedspace.

The client is a highly-experienced developer of both residential and commercial projects. Over the last 15 years, they have delivered multiple award-winning regeneration projects in both Scotland and England.

ESG: The development will be 100% car-free, will deliver 265sqm of new public realm, and will feature heat pumps throughout, and will achieve compliance with Glasgow's Gold Standard for carbon reduction.

title: Care Home Developments
sum: A facility to fund the development of two new-build care homes in Wiltshire
ps: The project comprises the development of two brand-new care homes in Wiltshire. The completed homes will provide over 140 beds for residents.

Both homes will boast extensive communal spaces including dining options, cinema, residents’ lounge, hobby / craft rooms, private gardens and other resident amenities. Both homes will also offer dementia and respite care, as well as general elderly care.
The developer is a highly-experienced and well-regarded developer and operator of specialist new-build care homes, with an impressive portfolio of operating homes across England.
ESG: Both homes will be fitted with internal and external LED lighting, movement sensors, air-source heat pumps and no gas boilers.

title: PBSA Development
sum: A facility to fund the development of 155 PBSA studios.
ps: The project comprises the development of 155 high-quality PBSA studios in an excellent location in Edinburgh, along with extensive communal facilities for the residents.
The GDV of the proposed development once completed is forecast to be in excess of £30m and will complete in time for the 2025/2026 academic year.
This is Beaufort's third transaction with this highly-experienced PBSA developer.
ESG: The scheme will be 100% car-free, and will also feature air-source heat pumps and solar panels for energy generation, with the completed project aiming for EPC 'B' or better.

title: PBSA Development
sum: A facility to fund the development of 139 PBSA studios.
ps: The project comprises the development of 139 high-quality PBSA studio rooms in this excellent city centre location in Southampton.

Located a stone's throw from Solent University, and a few metres from the main shopping precinct of the city, this scheme will boast extensive resident amenities, and roof terraces, offering views across the Solent.
The GDV of the proposed development once completed is forecast to be in excess of £30m and will complete in time for the 2026/2027 academic year.
This is Beaufort's second transaction with this highly-experienced PBSA developer.
ESG: The scheme will be 100% car-free, and will also feature air-source heat pumps and solar panels for energy generation, with the completed project aiming for EPC 'B' or better.

title: Self Storage Portfolio
sum: A facility to fund the development of 4 self-storage facilities.
ps: The project comprises the development of 4 new self-storage facilities in London, the South West and East of England.
The developer is highly-experienced in the development and operation of self-storage, and is backed by a major PE investor.
The GDV of the proposed development once completed is forecast to be approximately £50m.

ESG: Each site will present local full and part time employment opportunities, with management offering training courses and, due to the rapid expansion, career progression opportunities for staff. Each site will benefit from multiple energy-efficient strategies, such as low-energy lighting, PV panels and excellent insulation.

title: Light Industrial Project
sum: A facility to fund the acquisition, refurbishment and asset management of a light industrial estate
ps: The project comprises the acquisition and substantial renovation of a light industrial estate in Lincolnshire.
The developer, a repeat client of Beaufort, is highly-experienced in the light industrial sector, and has successfully refurbished and managed similar assets previously.

Works to the estate will include new trade counter units, PV Panels to be installed on all units, reducing the operating costs of the units, enabling higher rents and tighter yields, landscaping of the yard and surrounding area and improved signage.
ESG: The refurbishment works will enhance the EPC rating of all the units, making them more attractive to prospective tenants and investors.

title: PBSA Development
sum: A facility to fund the development of 814 PBSA units.
ps: The project comprises the development of 814 high-quality PBSA units in central Birmingham, set over 33 storeys.
This is Beaufort's second transaciton with the developer; a highly-experienced developer of high-quality, institutional-grade PBSA accommodation across the UK.
The completed project will boast substantial resident amenities, such as residents' lounges, study areas, gym, private dining room, cinema room and several private roof terraces.
ESG: The scheme will feature highly efficient individual heating and hot water systems to each unit, mechanical ventilation, PV panels and the use of sustainable materials where possible.

title: Retirement Development
sum: A facility to fund the development of 62 retirement living apartments.
ps: The project comprises the development of 62 high-quality retirement living apartments for the under served elderly community, complemented by 17,000 square feet of amenity space for the residents.
The GDV of the proposed development once completed is forecast to be approximately £50m.

ESG: The scheme will generate 12-15 full-time jobs upon the full occupation. The development will also feature air-source heat pumps and solar panels for energy generation, with the completed project aiming for EPC 'B' or better.

title: Aparthotel Development
sum: A facility to fund the development of a 64-suite aparthotel.
ps: The project comprises the restoration and conversion of a listed office building into 64 high-quality aparthotel suites, being developed by a well-established Edinburgh-based development company.
On-site amenities will encompass a communal lounge area, 24-hour concierge, gym, and weekly cleaning services.
The completed development will have a forecast GDV in excess of £30m.

ESG: The project involves the restoration of the listed building and the adjacent office building, rather than a demolition and rebuild, thus reducing the carbon impact of the development. Furthermore, the developer has removed single use plastics from 45% of their portfolio, removed 90% of harmful cleaning chemicals by investing in the latest cleaning technologies, and has removed short-life printed collateral from all of their guest suites, minimizing their impact on landfills.

title: Residential Development
sum: A facility to fund the development of 12 residential apartments and office space.
ps: The project comprises the refurbishment of the existing building, with additional floorspace added to the roof of the building. The development consists of 12 high-quality residential apartments and c.5,000 square feet of new office space in Covent Garden, central London.
The GDV of the proposed development once completed is forecast to be approximately £30m.
ESG: The completed development will boast air-to-water heat pumps to provide low-cost and low-carbon heating and hot water to the apartments, as well as new green roofs and dedicated cycle storage.

title: Care Home Development
sum: Mezzanine facility to support the development of a 70-bed care home and six close-care bungalows in Yorkshire.
ps: The new development is located on the edge of the village of Adel, just a short drive from Leeds. The ‘new generation’ care home features fully furnished private bedrooms with en-suite wet rooms, a selection of stylish communal lounges and elegant dining rooms, a hair dresser and nail bar as well as extensive landscaped gardens.

The developer is highly regarded within the sector as one of the country’s best care home operators, with a focus on personcentred care and the provision of specialist dementia care, as well as nursing and residential care.

title: Retirement Development
sum: Two Stretched Senior facilities to fund two separate retirement living projects for the same borrower.
ps: The first facility was utilised to refinance the development lender on a recently completed 53-unit scheme in Greater London. The second facility will fund the construction works of a 52-unit project in Surrey which will be completed in 2024.
Once completed the two schemes will have a combined value in excess of £80m and provide much needed high-spec retirement accommodation to the local communities.
The borrower is an experienced developer and a market leader within the retirement living sector.

ESG: The design of the buildings includes green walls and together with a net increase in the quantity of trees on both sites will support local wildlife. Energy saving features have been incorporated into the build and both sites have provision for electric car charging. Additionally, 24 full time jobs will be created once both sites are fully operational.

title: Residential Development
sum: Stretch Senior facility to fund the development of 8 houses and 87 apartments in central Edinburgh.
ps: The development involves the complete refurbishment of 7 existing buildings and is being undertaking by a well-established Edinburgh based developer.
ESG: The development will provide much needed new housing to the local Edinburgh market and return a disused building into a high-quality residential community.

title: Residential Development
sum: Senior Facility to fund the development of 25 apartments in Surrey.
ps: The scheme will be delivered across 2 blocks with all units benefiting from outdoor space in the form of private garden, terrace or balcony plus generous communal grounds and gated car parking.
This is Beaufort’s third transaction with this very-experienced award-winning developer.
ESG: All units are expected to receive the highest EPC rating. EV charging points will be provided to each of the 25 parking spaces.

title: Acquisition & Planning
sum: Senior Facility to fund the acquisition and planning of a PBSA and residential site in north London.
ps: This site, adjacent to an iconic London music venue, will provide 265 PBSA bedrooms and 24 affordable homes across three blocks.
In 2024, the council approved the Borrower's application. The developer is currently in the process of commencing works on site.

ESG: High levels of insulation and air tightness are proposed throughout the scheme to reduce heating requirements and 100% low energy lighting will be fitted. Additionally, the scheme will be car-free.

title: Residential Development
sum: A facility to support the development of 78 high-quality apartments and one commercial office unit in Surrey.
ps: The development is situated close to local transport links, shops, amenities and local parks. The development will be arranged across three blocks of four-storey buildings.
The borrower has several decades of experience in this location.

ESG: The development will boast high levels of insulation, air tightness, 100% low energy lighting, car club parking space, EV charging points, cycle parking as well as a forecast carbon reduction for the residential element of the scheme which exceeds the level required by local policy.

title: PBSA Development
sum: A facility to support the development of 426 PBSA beds in Nottingham.
ps: The development is excellently located close to Nottingham city centre, as well as Nottingham Trent University. The development will feature best-in-class accommodation and communal areas for the residents.
The developer is highly-experienced in delivery high-quality PBSA projects, and the project is due for delivery in time for the 2023/2024 academic year.

ESG: The design of the dwellings will maximise the amount of natural daylight available, which in conjunction with installing 100% low energy lighting and the use of room occupancy sensors to the bathroom and communal spaces will reduce the amount of energy consumed through artificial lighting.

title: Residential Development
sum: A facility to support the development of 263 apartments and houses in Kirkstall, Leeds.
ps: The development will transform a former brownfield site in this sought-after part of the city, which enjoys excellent transport links to the city centre. The site is located close to the attractions of Kirkstall Abbey and Headingley Cricket Ground.
This is Beaufort's fifth deal with this highly-experienced developer.

ESG: PV panels on all apartment blocks and residential roofs, energy-efficient appliances, 1:1 cycle storage, EPC 'A' rating for all residential units, bat & bird boxes and extensive landscaping throughout the site.

title: Acquisition & Planning
sum: A facility to support the acquisition and planning of a PBSA and residential site in central Edinburgh.
ps: Beaufort provided this facility to fund the acquisition and planning of a site in central Edinburgh.
The site achieved planning for 298 PBSA beds and 66 residential units, and was successfully sold on the grant of planning.

title: Residential Development
sum: A facility to support the development of 30 high-quality family houses and apartments in Send, Surrey.
ps: The development is set in a picturesque location, surrounded by both woodland and parkland on all sides. The popular commuter towns of Woking and Guildford are only 4.5 miles and 6 miles away respectively, making Send a popular location for families seeking a quiet area of residence, without sacrificing proximity to lively town centres.
This is Beaufort's third transaction with this highly-experienced developer.
ESG: 20% of the site's energy use will be from renewable energy sources, energy efficient appliances, PV panels, electric car charging points, 12 affordable houses.

title: Acquisition & Planning
sum: Facility to support the acquisition and planning costs of a planning transaction in Kensington, central London.
ps: Working with a highly-experienced and regarded real estate investment manager, the borrower will shortly submit an application to transform the site, a former educational building, into a small number of mews-style houses.
The houses, once complete, have a forecast GDV in excess of £50m.

title: Residential Development
sum: Facility to support the development of 124 one to five bedroom houses in South Queensferry, Midlothian, close to Edinburgh.
ps: The developer is an experienced Scottish developer and the site benefits from impressive views over the Firth of Forth.
The project has a forecast GDV in excess of £40m.
ESG: 26% affordable homes, EPC 'B' rating on all residential units, electric car charging stations, extensive and sympathetic landscaping throughout.

title: Residential Development
sum: Facility to support the development of 128 residential units centred around a picturesque lakeside location in Chelmsford, Essex.
ps: The developmnent, comprising both houses and apartments, is being undertaken by a very experienced developer and repeat borrower of Beaufort.
The forecast GDV of the whole project is projected to be £140m.

title: Residential Development
sum: Mezzanine facility to fund the development of a £30m scheme in Warwickshire.
ps: The project, in the village of Pickford Green near Coventry, will deliver 115 family houses, comprising 2, 3 and 4 bedrooms within a rural setting with substantial green space.
The Birmingham-based developer currently has eight projects being delivered in locations across Coventry, Worcester and Cotswolds with a combined forecast GDV of c.£80m.

title: Residential Development
sum: Mezzanine facility to fund the building of 40 high-quality family homes in Binfield, Berkshire.
ps: The development will be undertaken by Burrington Estates, a well-established property developer based in the South West and this is the second transaction that Beaufort has closed with Burrington Estates in 2021.

The development is set across two sites and features a mix of detached and semi-detached three and four-bedroom homes, each with large private gardens. The development will also feature affordable homes, as well as landscaped communal gardens.
The first houses were completed by Q2 2022.

title: Residential Development
sum: Mezzanine facility to fund the building of 93 high-quality family homes in Binfield, Berkshire.
ps: The development will be undertaken by Burrington Estates, a well-established property developer based in the South West.

The development is set across two sites and features a mix of detached and semi-detached three and four-bedroom homes, each with large private gardens. The development will also feature affordable homes, as well as landscaped communal gardens.
The first houses were completed by Q1 2022.

title: Residential Development
sum: Mezzanine facility to support the development of 48 high-quality family homes with a very experienced and award-winning home counties developer.
ps: The site is located adjacent to woodland and provides easy access to the town centre, the train station as well as local schools and amenities. The development provides a mix of semi-detached and detached homes, set within landscaped communal gardens.
The first homes were completed in Q1 2022

title: Residential Development
sum: Mezzanine facility to support the development of twenty 3 and 4 bedroom houses in Berkshire with a high-quality and very experienced developer.
ps: Based in a semi-rural setting and with plenty of space within and surrounding the development, each unit will be built to a high specification, and will boast a private garden, as well as extensive communal landscaped space.

The development will also achieve a reduction in CO2 emissions of 48.84% and energy consumption by 28.83% thanks to the construction methods used, as well as the use of photovoltaic panels on a number of the units

title: Light Industrial Development
sum: Mezzanine and equity investment for the acquisition and refurbishment of 11 light industrial units in Peterborough.
ps: The site benefits from a prominent local location, and is well connected to main roads and local transport links.
The developer undertook a rolling programme of refurbishment, together with regearing existing leases, to create a high-quality product for the local market.

title: Residential Development
sum: Investment to support the acquisition and development of 120 high-quality and sustainable residential units in Edinburgh.
ps: The site is located in the west of the city, situated close to a host of local amenities, and provides excellent transport links into the city, as well as Edinburgh airport.
Beaufort is delighted to be supporting this highly-experienced developer, with a proven track record of award-winning projects in Edinburgh, as well as the rest of the UK.

title: PBSA Development
sum: Mezzanine investment for the development of 166 high-quality purpose-built PBSA units in Egham, Surrey.
ps: The site is located less than five minutes' walk from the main campus of Royal Holloway, part of the University of London and features a gym, residents' lounge, cycle storage, landscaped gardens and quiet study areas. The scheme was successfully delivered for the 2021/2022 academic year.

The project was delivered by Danehurst Developments, a specialist developer of purpose-built PBSA. Danehurst has delivered three previous high quality PBSA projects in Egham and a scheme in Kingston upon Thames. All previous student developments have proved extremely popular and have been fully let during every year of operation.

title: Mixed-Use Development
sum: Mezzanine investment to support the first phase of a development of 1,725 new homes, commercial space and school in Hertfordshire.
ps: The entire site, situated adjacent to Cheshunt station, and which includes the former Tesco HQ, will deliver 1,725 new homes, including a minimum of 185 affordable homes, along with approximately 200,000 sqft of commercial space and a two-form entry primary school. The projected GDV of the completed project is forecast to be in excess of £600m.

The development is being undertaken by a leading brownfield developer, housebuilder and partnership housing company with a focus on the south and southeast of England. It currently has a land bank of nearly 8,000 plots with a GDV in excess of £2bn.

title: Residential Development
sum: Mezzanine development facility to a long-established Essex based housebuilder to support the development of a £70m residential scheme in Chelmsford.
ps: The project will deliver 128 family houses and apartments on land which previously formed part of Channels Lake Golf Club. A number of the units will benefit from lakeside frontage and private jetties.

Chelmsford’s population consists of a large number of London commuters attracted by the 35-minute journey time by train to London Liverpool Street. Chelmsford benefits from good-quality leisure and retail including the new Bond Street development where John Lewis is the anchor tenant.

title: Residential Development
sum: Mezzanine facility to support the development of 77 high-quality residential units plus retail space in York.
ps: The property is located in the centre of the York, moments from the city’s main attractions and features a concierge service as well as a convenience store, gym and F&B offerings in the retail space. The development was delivered in Spring 2021.

The development was undertaken by prominent local developer, Newby. Established in 2008, Newby specialises in developing mixed-use and residential schemes with an identified project pipeline in excess of £100m worth of GDV.

title: PBSA Development
sum: Mezzanine investment to support the development of 201 purpose-built PBSA units in Coventry.
ps: Amenities include a gym, cinema room, bicycle storage centred around a striking rotunda structure. The development was completed in time for the start of the 2020 academic year with a forecast GDV in excess of £20m. The site is well-located in an established residential area and it has access to the full range of services and facilities and is situated within easy reach of the nearby Warwick University campus.

This is the second transaction that Beaufort has completed with multiple award-winning development and construction company, Torsion Group. This project was undertaken by Torsion in joint venture with DR2H, a Coventry-based firm specialising in the delivery of serviced residential and mixed-use developments.

title: PBSA Development
sum: Equity investment to support the acquisition, planning and development of a 321-bed PBSA development in the centre of Glasgow.
ps: The site is located in the central business district of Glasgow, and the project will transform a former office building into a brand new PBSA scheme, offering extensive amenity space and communal roof terraces.
Once complete, the GDV of the development is forecast to be in excess of £60m.

title: Residential Development
sum: Investment to support the development of 130 high-quality private and affordable homes in Wembley, North West London.
ps: The development features a striking design and will play a significant part in contributing towards the regeneration and enhancement of the local area. The site is located on the doorstep of major transport links and local amenities, and will provide an iconic residential development for the local area.

title: PBSA Development
sum: Mezzanine investment to support the development of 220 student cluster beds and studios in the heart of Sheffield.
ps: The development has a host of amenities on its doorstep and caters to students of both the University of Sheffield and Sheffield Hallam University.
Construction was completed on time to welcome the first students for the start of the 2019/2020 academic year.
Facility Size: £3,500,000 mezzanine facility

title: Residential Development
sum: Mezzanine investment to support the development of a multi-unit residential development in Hampstead, North London.
ps: The development is located within a short walk of Hampstead Heath and the amenities of Hampstead village. Comprising over 19,500 sqft of internal area, the units will be finished to a very high standard with landscaped gardens.
The project was completed in Q2 2022.
Facility Size: £3,500,000 mezzanine facility

title: PBSA Development
sum: Mezzanine investment to support the development of a 301-bed purpose-build PBSA scheme in Glasgow.
ps: Completed in summer 2019, the 301-student bed development was built close to and in conjunction with the Royal Conservatoire of Scotland, one of the top five performing arts institutions in the world. The RCS was founded in 1845 and counts King Charles III as its patron and Cameron Mackintosh as president of the University. The project provides students with a wealth of amenities including; five bespoke sound-proofed music practice rooms, a dance studio, a gym, cinema room, study halls, two roof terraces and a sky lounge.
With a high specification and market-leading amenities, the development appeals to students from a number of the many higher education institutions in Glasgow.
Boasting a mixture of shared flats, studio and cluster accommodation, the range of price points ensures an appeal to a wide mix of students.
Facility Size: £5,500,000 mezzanine facility

title: Residential Development
sum: Mezzanine investment to City & Country, the UK's leading developer of heritage properties.
ps: The facility supports two of City & Country's prestige developments in Bristol; The General and Factory No.1.

The General is a multiple-award winning development of 205 residential units and four commercial units at the former general hospital in the centre of Bristol. Originally opened in 1858, the hospital finally closed its doors in 2012.

City & Country has set about a painstaking renovation and conversion of the property, setting new record prices for the local market with the first two phases of the development. The property also boasts a Michelin starred restaurant on the ground floor.

Factory No.1 is a former tobacco factory located on the main thoroughfare of Bedminster, a stone's throw from the centre of Bristol. The development will consist of a range of 288 one, two and three bedroom apartments across converted and new-build elements.
Facility Size: £7,750,000 mezzanine facility

title: Hotel & Residential Development
sum: Mezzanine facility to fund the acquisition and development of a hotel and residential project in central Liverpool.
ps: The facility supported the acquisiton and planning enhancement of an iconic building in the centre of Liverpool.
The developer obtained planning consent for a change of use from retail to a 155-key hotel and 53 residential units, set over the existing eight-storey building plus a four-storey extension.
The consented development was forward-sold to a major European hotelier.

title: Residential Development
sum: Mezzanine and equity investment into an exciting residential development project in Edinburgh being delivered by a multiple-award winning developer.
ps: The site, located in the highly sought-after Canonmills area, has full consent for 180 residential units across four blocks, with landscaped gardens and common amenities, with an anticipated GDV of over £50m.
The developer has an enviable track record and is involved in several flagship schemes around the UK. Beaufort is delighted to be supporting a developer of such high calibre.
Facility Size: £3,800,000 mezzanine facility and £2,500,000 equity investment

title: Hotel Development
sum: Equity investment for a brand-new 300 bed hotel and 150 bed apart-hotel in the centre of Glasgow.
ps: The site was previously occupied by two derelict listed properties. The development will retain the original facade, while providing much-needed hotel and conference space to the centre of Glasgow. Both properties are a stone's throw from the world-class shopping of Buchanan Street as well as the central station.
The completed hotel and apart-hotel was purchased at completion by a major European institutional investor. Beaufort is delighted to be supporting the regeneration of this city centre site.

title: Aparthotel Development
sum: Equity investment for a brand-new 300 bed hotel and 150 bed apart-hotel in the centre of Glasgow.
ps: The site was previously occupied by two derelict listed properties. The development will retain the original facade, while providing much-needed hotel and conference space to the centre of Glasgow. Both properties are a stone's throw from the world-class shopping of Buchanan Street as well as the central station.
The completed hotel and apart-hotel was purchased at completion by a major European institutional investor. Beaufort is delighted to be supporting the regeneration of this city centre site.

title: Extra-Care Development
sum: Mezzanine and equity investment for the acquisition, planning and delivery of a new extra-care scheme in London.
ps: This development will transform a derelict site into a first-class scheme for people looking to downsize and ensure their current and future care needs are met, but retain their independence.
In addition to excellent amenities, such as a library, bistro, bar, spa and swimming pool, the development will feature landscaped gardens which will be open to the public.
This development will go some way to catering for the huge demand for specialist extra-care schemes in London.
Facility Size: £14,500,000 mezzanine facility and £4,000,000 equity investment across two phases

title: Hotel & Residential Development
sum: Facility to support a mixed use development including a 110 bedroom hotel, 11 retail units, 12 apartments and 4 affordable apartments.
ps: This property, in an enviable location in the heart of Soho, has been transformed by this exciting mixed-use development.

The completed development comprises a mixed use development including a 110 bedroom ‘Hub by Premier Inn’ hotel, a Co-Op foodstore and a further 10 retail units, 12 apartments and 4 affordable apartments with a GDV of c.£100m.
This development is a landmark development, forming the centrepiece of the regeneration of this part of Soho.
Facility Size: £12,500,000 working capital facility.

title: Supported Living Accommodation
sum: Working capital facility to fund the expansion of the foremost developer of supported living properties across the UK.
ps: The facility was structured with maximum flexibility, to allow the borrower to draw down the facility against pre-agreed criteria, to minimise the time spent on documentation, and to ensure that properties are acquired, refurbished, let and sold as quickly as possible.
This provided much-needed first-class supported living housing to local authorities, easing the care burden on the NHS and local authority resources.
Facility Size: £10,000,000 working capital facility.

title: Acquisition & Planning
sum: The developer has acquired a 7 acre site in Romford and received planning for more than 600 residential units plus commercial space across several blocks.
ps: The Beaufort facility allowed the developer to acquire the site and fund planning costs to transform this site into a sought-after location, minutes from the town centre. Planning was received in summer 2018.
Romford currently benefits from excellent transport locations into central London, and will form part of the CrossRail route from 2021.
Facility Size: £7,000,000 mezzanine facility.

title: Residential Development
sum: The borrower, a developer with considerable track record, acquired two adjacent buildings in this sought-after location in South Kensington.
ps: Close to the amenities of Gloucester Road, the project involved the transformation of the buildings from hostels into 12 desirable self-contained apartments, restoring a previously unloved building in an imposing corner location back to its former period glory.
The communal areas of the property also feature artwork done by a local art college and commissioned by the borrower.
Facility Size: £5,000,000 mezzanine facility.
